_doc: THE FULL EIGHT — Book's special ability (story bible §4). Eight seconds of bull-rider time dilation; the meter is a bull rope. Charged by holding on: speed, air, towing at speed, near misses, the slab strip, shaking a tail. Read by systems/full_eight.gd at boot; T hot-reloads vehicles only, so relaunch for these.
_tuning: duration is canon (eight seconds); time_scale 0.35 keeps the engine note readable at audio_pitch 0.55; a full rope from pure speed takes ~36 s on the freeway, ~6 s of air, ~20 s of a hot tow — hold on and it fills.
